rationale: The Court will likely deny the stay on narrow, emergency-posture grounds: contested facts and insufficient likelihood of success under a cabined statutory “for cause” standard, with Humphrey’s Executor/Wiener as the controlling baseline. Separate writings are most likely from the dissenters pressing irreparable Article II injury and from one or more majority justices emphasizing that the order does not resolve the broader constitutionality of for-cause protection for the Fed.
